_readme: Hand-maintained. One list of sections per theme, shown on the theme page. extract = which extractor in scripts/build-mechanics.mjs pulls the entries from the game data. kind = debuff | buff | mixed (shown under 'Buffs & Debuffs') or item (shown under 'Special Items'). title, summary and groups (EN group names) are free text: edit them, then run node scripts/build-mechanics.mjs --skip-icons.

rogue_1.title: Plays
rogue_1.summary: One-use items: a Play takes effect in the next battle on the current floor.

rogue_1.title: Support Devices
rogue_1.summary: Devices your squad brings along and can deploy in every battle.

rogue_2.title: Light
rogue_2.summary: Light runs down as you explore. The dimmer it gets, the worse things get for your run.

rogue_2.title: Echoes
rogue_2.summary: Floor-wide changes that usually trade a benefit for a cost.

rogue_2.title: Virtues
rogue_2.summary: Nation blessings that give your squad an edge in battle.

rogue_3.title: Collapsal Paradigms
rogue_3.summary: Collapse builds up over a run. Each threshold adds a Collapsal Paradigm, a run-wide debuff that can intensify further.

rogue_3.title: Foldartals
rogue_3.summary: Used in pairs: an upper Foldartal picks which nodes are affected, a lower one decides what happens there.

rogue_4.title: Epochs
rogue_4.summary: An Epoch changes battles for the rest of the run and grows worse over three stages.

rogue_4.title: Thoughts
rogue_4.summary: Usable items: some are spent for a one-off effect, others are combined with another Thought.

rogue_5.title: Hours of Sui
rogue_5.summary: Run-wide debuffs that escalate over four stages.

rogue_5.title: Tongbao
rogue_5.summary: Coins you toss and keep in your Coffer. Each grants its effect while you hold it.

rogue_6.title: Weather
rogue_6.summary: Weather changes battles and the map, growing stronger over three stages. Most of it hurts; a little helps.

rogue_6.title: Floor Variations
rogue_6.summary: Special battle conditions that apply on some floors.

rogue_6.title: Scrap
rogue_6.summary: Three kinds: processed goods let you move on the map, natural objects sell for Originium Ingots, and concepts trigger when you move onto certain nodes.
